set.body: From the cold review of 97161f239 (ADR 0027 §5). (a) A proposal row merges the producer-guard outcome and the resolver outcome into one; record both. (b) Proposal rows drop name, hint basis and direction. (c) A presence refusal is identified only by array index; add its interval and receipt. (d) A missing producer reason silently becomes an empty string; refuse it.
set.title: S3c-1 follow-up F1: graph output keeps producer and resolver outcomes apart
